deviations.description: Uses primitive greybox character/enemy/salvage visuals. Frozen shared production assets are intentionally deferred to Phase B.
deviations.effect_on_claims: No final asset-import, animation-fidelity, production-visual or production-content mobile-performance claims are permitted.

deviations.effect_on_claims: Measures navigation/steering and engine plumbing only; does not establish obstacle/pathfinding capability.
